about: Per-line results ruled by the maintainer on the decision page (https://claude.ai/artifact/Jjv2qdtPzyDcvRHiZaSt7Y) where the general parser does not produce them. Applied by scripts/build_amis_chinese_xml.py after the records are built. 'headwords' / 'examples' replace every head-word / example S of that line; 'add_alt_translation' appends a ver="alt" Chinese TRANSL to one S; 'replace_chinese' rewrites one Chinese TRANSL text and adds a note; 'alt_forms' turns the listed forms into FORM ver="alt" of the first. Each item quotes the ruling.
